login.title: Welcome Back
login.subtitle: Sign in to save your progress and access your career results
login.haveCredentials: Have login credentials? Use the email sign-in option above.
login.errorGoogle: Google login failed. Please try again.
login.errorMicrosoft: Microsoft login failed. Please try again.
login.noAccountGoogle: No account found for that Google address.
login.noAccountMicrosoft: No account found for that Microsoft address.
login.oauthUnavailable: Social sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Use the email option below.
login.noAccountYet: Parent or guardian without an account?

register.retiredTitle: Free accounts are no longer available
register.retiredBody: This page used to create a free account directly. That option has been retired — register as a parent to save your child's results and continue.

registerParent.consentGuardian: I am {{child}}'s parent or legal guardian.
registerParent.consentProcessing: I consent to Future Path processing {{child}}'s personal data on {{child}}'s behalf, as described in the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
registerParent.title: Create Your Account
registerParent.subtitle: A parent or guardian creates the account for their child. It is free: the assessment and its report are saved to the account, and you can upgrade to the full report whenever you like.
registerParent.errorDesc: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.childDobRequired: Enter the student's date of birth

registerParent.createdDesc: We have emailed you a link. Please confirm your address within 72 hours to keep the account.
registerParent.createdMailFailed: The account is ready, but the confirmation email could not be sent. Use "Send again" at the top of the page.

studentLogin.title: Login
studentLogin.subtitle: Enter the username and password provided by your school
studentLogin.noAccount: Don't have an account? Contact your school administrator.
studentLogin.errorGeneric: An error occurred. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email or username and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.checkEmailDesc: If an account exists with that email or username, we've sent password reset instructions.
forgotPassword.expiry: The reset link will expire in 1 hour. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.

resetPassword.title: Reset Your Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter your new password below. Make sure it's strong and unique.
resetPassword.invalidDesc: This password reset link is missing the required token.
resetPassword.expiredDesc: This password reset link has expired or is invalid. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.successDesc: Your password has been reset successfully. You can now log in with your new password.
resetPassword.successToastDesc: Your password has been reset successfully.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.uppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter
validation.lowercase: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter
validation.number: Password must contain at least one number

callback.migratedDesc: Your assessment has been saved to your account.

schoolSetup.choosePasswordDesc: You are setting up {{school}}. Your sign-in name is {{username}}.
schoolSetup.confirmsEmail: Setting a password confirms this email address belongs to you.
schoolSetup.countryTitle: Which country is your school in?
schoolSetup.countryDesc: This decides which national priorities your students' career reports are weighted against, and which question bank their quiz is drawn from.
schoolSetup.countryNotice: Taken from your purchase. Change it now if it is wrong — once students have sat an assessment it is locked, because every report records the country it was produced under.
schoolSetup.curriculumDesc: Your students' subject quiz is drawn from this curriculum's question bank, at each student's own grade. Pick the one your school actually teaches.
schoolSetup.curriculumNotice: This locks once a student completes an assessment. Every report stores the curriculum it was drawn under, so changing it later would leave your school and your past reports disagreeing.
schoolSetup.peopleDesc: Adding a student costs nothing. A licence is spent only when a student finishes an assessment and their report is generated.
schoolSetup.uploadDesc: Name, grade and date of birth for each student. We generate their sign-in details and give you a printable list.
schoolSetup.oneByOneTitle: Add them one at a time
schoolSetup.oneByOneDesc: Better for a handful of students, or for adding a colleague as a second school administrator.
schoolSetup.licencesNote: Spent at report generation, never at enrolment
schoolSetup.readyDesc: Your students can sit their assessment now. Everything can be changed from your school settings, except where noted.
schoolSetup.signedInDesc: This setup link has been used, and your password is set. Carry on from your school page: anything still to finish is shown there.
schoolSetup.deadLinkTitle: This setup link is no longer valid
schoolSetup.deadLinkDesc: It may have been used already or expired. Your account still exists — sign in, or ask us to send a new link.
schoolSetup.couldNotSetDesc: Please try again, or ask for a new setup link.
schoolSetup.consentDesc: Your students are aged 13–18 and your school creates their accounts, so your school is the consenting party. This record is what allows you to enrol anyone.
schoolSetup.consentRequired: Both confirmations are required before you can enrol students.

banner.title: Confirm your email address
banner.daysLeft: {{days}} days left, then the account is deleted
banner.hoursLeft: {{hours}} hours left, then the account is deleted
banner.overdue: the account will be deleted shortly
banner.resentDesc: A new link is on its way to {{email}}. Earlier links no longer work.
banner.resendFailedDesc: Please try again in a few minutes.

page.title: Confirm your email
page.confirmedBody: Thank you. The account and its reports are kept.
page.expiredBody: Sign in and press "Send again" for a new one. If more than 72 hours have passed since registering, the account has been deleted and you can register again.
page.invalidBody: It may have been replaced by a newer email, or the account may have been deleted. Sign in and press "Send again", or register again.
page.errorBody: We could not confirm the address just now. Please open the link again in a few minutes.
